experiments.procedure: Warm engine normally, hold stable idle, avoid accessory toggles, record at least 5 minutes.
experiments.purpose: Verify no-evidence/low-alert behavior during stable idle/reference operation.

experiments.procedure: Run several gentle throttle transitions from closed to low/mid load in a safe stationary or controlled setting.
experiments.purpose: Check IF response to repeatable operating-state transitions without treating them as faults.

experiments.procedure: Toggle safe factory electrical loads where appropriate and record external voltage if available.
experiments.purpose: Check contextual battery detector response to independently observed voltage changes.

experiments.procedure: Repeat the same route/idle protocol across sessions under similar conditions.
experiments.purpose: Estimate repeatability and normal operating variation without using detector output as truth.

safety_policy: Do not introduce unsafe mechanical or electrical faults.
Prefer reversible operating changes and repeated nominal baselines.
Record raw capture, ECU profile, environmental notes, operator action and timestamps.
